Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring notification to property owners of emergency responses to property titled in their name.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring notification to property owners ofemergency responses to property titled in their name; adding a newsection to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 43.43 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 52.30 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A municipal agency shall notify a property owner of a municipalagency's response to an emergency on property titled in the owner'sname within twentyfour hours of the response by the municipal agency. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Emergency" means an incident that requires a normal police,coroner, fire, rescue, emergency medical services, or utility response. (b) "Municipal agency" includes police, coroner, fire, rescue,emergency medical services, or utility department maintained orcontracted by the municipality.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A municipal agency shall notify a property owner of a municipalagency's response to an emergency on property titled in the owner'sname within twentyfour hours of the response by the municipal agency. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Emergency" means an incident that requires a normal police,coroner, fire, rescue, emergency medical services, or utility response. (b) "Municipal agency" includes police, coroner, fire, rescue,emergency medical services, or utility department maintained orcontracted by the municipality.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A county agency shall notify a property owner of a countyagency's response to an emergency on property titled in the owner'sname within twentyfour hours of the response by the county agency. (2) For purposes of this section: (a) "Emergency" means an incident that requires a normal sheriff,coroner, fire, rescue, emergency medical services, or utility response. (b) "County agency" includes a sheriff, coroner, fire, rescue,emergency medical services, or utility department maintained orcontracted by the county.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The Washington state patrol shall notify a property owner ofthe Washington state patrol's response to an emergency on propertytitled in the owner's name within twentyfour hours of the response bythe Washington state patrol. (2) For purposes of this section "emergency" means an incident thatrequires a normal state patrol, coroner, fire, rescue, emergencymedical services, or utility response.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 52.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A fire protection district shall notify a property owner of a HB 1537 p. 2 fire protection district's response to an emergency on property titledin the owner's name within twentyfour hours of the response by thefire protection district. (2) For purposes of this section "emergency" means an incident thatrequires a normal sheriff, coroner, fire, rescue, emergency medicalservices, or utility response.
